qualification: Locally implemented and tested. No push, merge, deployment, production database operation or customer-data cleanup. Overall production qualification still depends on remaining PRs and external gates.

controls.continuous: Composite tenant FKs, optional hierarchy unit tuple, immutable referenced-object tenant, existence checked separately from NULL/global parent.
controls.rvtAssociation: Customer/unit checked at reference insert/change, including equipment arrays and equipment evidence; historical snapshots deliberately not reinterpreted against current asset ownership.
controls.preflight: READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ, administrative visibility required, row_security=off, counts/rule IDs only, no implicit dotenv, exit 0/2/1.
controls.migration: Transactional, preflight before DDL, NOT VALID followed by VALIDATE for every new FK, trigger-rule recheck after locks, no data updates/deletes, lock_timeout 10s and per-statement timeout 10min.
controls.optionalDeletion: SET NULL restricted to reference ID; child organization preserved.
controls.indexes: Reuses compatible unique/lookup indexes instead of blindly duplicating every FK index.
controls.privileges: Trigger-only definer functions have fixed search_path and no direct EXECUTE for runtime/PUBLIC; provisioning publishes function grants/revocations atomically.

exceptions.globalIdentity: Users remain global and may belong to multiple organizations. Global templates/roles retain their existing authorization/provenance rules.
exceptions.pushInstallation: Historical mobile_push_deliveries reference a physical installation that is deliberately rebound across accounts/tenants; current sender verifies installation/user/tenant and skips obsolete deliveries.
exceptions.nullableUnit: Organization-wide calendars/media/catalog and aggregate/history links retain existing sharing semantics; RLS/application authorization still required.
exceptions.mutableAssetHistory: Current unit/customer of an asset can change within its tenant without rewriting past snapshots; association-time RVT guards reject invalid new links.

ancillaryCorrection: Cold recovery checkpoint initializes next_run_at using date_trunc(milliseconds,now()) so timestamptz(3) rounding cannot make it later than the same transaction now(). No payment values, periods or idempotency rules changed.

intermediateFailures: First direct foreign-unit assertion was intercepted by RLS; the test now grants both unit IDs in context and still requires the FK rejection, without changing production RLS.
Rebindable mobile installation identified as a temporal identity exception rather than freezing/reparenting historical deliveries.

Initial full E2E: 652 passed, five failed; PMOC fixture exceeded ingress quota, cold recovery timestamp precision, ambiguous legacy fixture, two guard fixtures with nonexistent tenants. All addressed without weakening assertions; final full E2E passed.
Repeated units exposed an implicit-listener routing fixture; stabilized loopback listener and complete unit rerun passed.
